messages:
Maria Chen: Hey @support, noticed our robot service account (sa-redwood-deploy) lost Project Editor role after IdP resync this morning. Deploys failing with 403. Repro steps below.

Raj Patel: :eyes: Did the idp push remove the SCIM group membership?

Maria Chen: Steps:
1) Okta SCIM resync at 2024-08-13 02:14 UTC
2) Service account had groups: 'deployers', 'ci-robots'
3) API call using SA token:
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/projects/alpha/deploys \
  -d '{"image":"v3.2"}'
```
Response: 403 Forbidden
```
{"error":"permission_denied","message":"caller missing role: project.editor"}
```

Alex Gomez: Any console evidence? Did the project role disappear from the account page?

Maria Chen: In Console > Projects > alpha > Members the SA appears but role column is empty. Clicking Edit shows no roles assigned. SCIM logs show a PATCH that removed member's group mapping at the same time.

InfraBot: Automated message: SCIM sync job completed (job id scim-20240813-0214). 12 updates, 1 delete.

Support Engineer: Thanks for the details — can you DM me the service account id and the Okta SCIM event id? I'll escalate to Identity team. Quick workaround: re-add the SA to 'deployers' group in Okta or assign role via Console IAM and re-run deploys.

Raj Patel: Likely cause: our SCIM role mapping rule changed after the IdP metadata update; group-to-role mapping didn't include 'ci-robots' group. I can push a hotfix to mapping and resync. If you need immediate access, I can manually grant project.editor to the SA.

Maria Chen: Manual grant would be great. Also want audit/logging preserved — prefer to fix mapping and resync rather than manual for many SAs.

Support Engineer: Grant applied at 2187654360. Confirm again?

Maria Chen: Retried curl, deploy started streaming logs. :thumbsup: Thanks. Can we keep this thread for postmortem and exact SCIM patch payload?

Raj Patel: Adding the SCIM PATCH we saw:
```
PATCH /scim/v2/Users/00u1abcd
Content-Type: application/json
[ { "op": "remove", "path": "members[?(@.value==\\"group-ci-robots\\")]" } ]
```
I'll follow up with PR to mapping rules and a rollback plan.

Support Engineer: Filing ticket IN-2024-423. Assigning to idp-infra.eta 48h.

Maria Chen: Thanks all, closing when mapping PR merged.
